== virtualUSB

=== Fixed: Linux log export now includes the device connection log

- On Linux, `vusb export-logs` now includes the virtualUSB device connection log for the requested number of days. Previously, the exported archive contained only the virtualUSB configuration and CLI log, so it could not be used to troubleshoot device connection problems.
- The archive also includes the system journal entries for the device connection service, so exported archives are larger than before.
- Rotated device connection logs are included.
- Logs written before you install this update are not included in the export.
- To include the system journal entries, run `vusb export-logs` as a user in the `adm` or `systemd-journal` group. For other users, the journal file in the archive is empty, but the device connection log is still included.
- virtualUSB on macOS and Windows is unchanged.
